maya chen: Quick recap from today's EBR prep call — let's produce a single-page exec summary + a short ops appendix (latency, cost, onboarding KPIs). I sketched owners below. If anything looks off, call it out.
samir: I'll do the ops appendix. Plan: 95/99th latency by route, 30-day token spend trend, and a tiny cost-per-endpoint table. Need the billing slice for the last 30 days.
jorge l: I'll own the onboarding KPIs. Current status: 6/8 checklist items passed; remaining blockers are webhook cert rotation and a permissions mismatch on the import job. I can create a remediation runbook for the certs. ETA Wed EOD for the runbook.
alina: Renewal risk notes from my calls: admin adoption low (teams not enabling SSO), and one org hesitant about dedicated commitment due to cost uncertainty. I have verbatim quotes. I'll synthesize into 2-3 exec bullets.
katie: I'll take enablement deliverables. I'll put together an SSO "playbook" (short doc + walkthrough deck) and record a 6-minute screencast. Propose a 30-min live session next Tuesday.
ryan: FYI I told the AM to surface the specific high-usage prompts that spike token counts — they said they'll share sanitized examples by EOD.
samir: Great — with sanitized payloads I can annotate which routes cause the token jumps. Also: want to include one row for "projected cost w/ Dedicated pilot" vs "current" to justify ask. Need finance baseline.
maya chen: @ryan can you paste the baseline committed numbers here when you get them? Also @alina please keep the quotes to one sentence each. Execs prefer short, concrete statements.
ryan: committed baseline: 120k tokens/day committed -> current avg 95k/day. Pasted to doc.
alina: Draft bullets: 1) Admins delayed SSO adoption due to unclear setup docs, 2) Nightly batch latencies spike and impact job windows, 3) CFO unsure of ROI on Dedicated without a pilot. I'll refine into one-liners and drop into the drive.
jorge l: On the webhook cert: support ticket #AC-2345 shows the cert TTL is misconfigured in their infra. I'll add step-by-step CLI snippets and escalate to support to push patch with customer.
katie: Workshop invite: "Acme SSO playbook + quick demo" Tue 11am PT. I'll include the recorded screencast and a short Q&A slot. Calendar invite pending AM confirmation.
notebook-bot: Created folder: https://drive.redwood.example/EBR/acme-onepager (files: one-pager.md, ops-appendix.png, onboarding-slide.png)
maya chen: Slide/asset owners so far: one-pager: maya, ops appendix: samir, onboarding slide: jorge, risk bullets: alina, enablement collateral: katie. Who will draft the formal asks? We need two asks: 1) 90-day Dedicated pilot with defined committed rate, 2) approval to prioritize SSO engineering work.
alina: I'll draft the risk + ask language for the one-pager; keep it succinct.
samir: I can model a projected cost delta for the pilot once I have the committed baseline.
maya chen: Deadline to upload final assets: Thursday 17:00 PT. Please add files to the folder above. We'll rehearse Friday 09:30 PT for a 20-min dry run.
jorge l: Uploading onboarding slide + sanitized payloads Wed 11:30 PT.
samir: Ops appendix PNG uploading Thu 11:00 PT.
katie: Playbook + screencast uploaded Wed EOD, calendar invite sent after AM confirms.
ryan: AM will confirm attendee list by EOD.
maya chen: Final presenter plan: maya opens with ask and context, samir covers ops appendix numbers, alina runs the risk bullets, jorge covers onboarding remediation. Katie available for live questions. Agree?
